groups.name:
No indication Home/Away Goal (No Onwards)
Filter by Accept Time
description: Provider missed or delayed Score show by more than one (1) minute.
=> Missed update Home/Away score -> But there is happened score awarded.
Att: Actual Goal/Corner/Goal kick/booking compare last ticket trans.time base on 1 min to use message type.
Over 1 min consider wrong score/Missed > Goal/Corner/Goal kick/booking 10:00:00, last ticket trans.time 10:01:00.
Within 1mins consider danger accept Goal/Corner/Goal kick/booking 10:00:00, last ticket trans.time 10:00:20.
* Home Missed > Request Home. Away Missed > Request Away.

groups.name: Wrong Indication Goal (No Onwards)<div class='text-danger'>Filter by Trans Time
description: Provider wrong display Home/Away Score and/or in fact there is no Score awarded.
=> Wrong update Home/Away score -> But there is 'No Score' awarded.
Example: 0-0 to 0-1, Cancel Goal, all 0-1 need void all. Single team O/U home team score 0-0 accept after Goal valid.
We use transtime to void, TVS will auto detect wrong score range time.

groups.name: Wrong Indication Swap Team Score (No Onwards)<div class='text-danger'>Filter by Trans Time & Accept Time
description: Provider wrong display Swap Team Score.
=> Wrong update Away Score -> Correct there is Home Score awarded. So Single team O/U home team admin will wrong accept.
Example: 0-0 to 0-1 wrong update,  Correct is 1-0, need void all ticket. Single team O/U home team score 0-0 accept after Goal is wrong, need void all.
